newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd Road sells Schiphol warehouse unit.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd Road sells Schiphol warehouse unit.

text.p: Dutch road haulage group Nedlloyd Road Cargo B.V. is to sell its Schiphol-based warehouse operation to the privately-owned group Jan de Rijk Special Airport Deliveries B.V.
In a statement, Nedlloyd Road Cargo, owned by Nedlloyd NV, said the two companies have signed a letter of intent for 3,300 sq m of warehousing at Schiphol. No purchase price was disclosed.

Nedlloyd Road Cargo said the operation no longer fits with its airfreight-related activities. Both companies are expected to conclude the deal in the next few weeks, the statement added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
